vbox_username.description: Username for authenticating with the VirtualBox web service (must have VM control permissions).

vbox_password.description: Password for the above username. Recommended to use a secure credential store (e.g., via agent or environment) — do not store plaintext if avoidable.

vbox_host.description: Hostname or IP address where the VirtualBox host service (VBoxHeadless/VBoxWebSrv) runs.

vbox_port.description: TCP port used by the VirtualBox web service (default: 18083).

vbox_protocol.description: Communication protocol: 'http' or 'https'. Use 'https' in production for security.

vbox_vmname.description: Name of the VirtualBox VM to fence. Must exactly match the VM name as shown by `VBoxManage list vms`.

vbox_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a fence command (e.g., power-off/on) to complete.

vbox_insecure.description: If true (set to '1'), skip SSL certificate validation for HTTPS connections (e.g., for self-signed certs). Not recommended for production.

vbox_cacert.description: Absolute path to a custom CA certificate bundle (PEM format) for HTTPS validation. Overrides system trust store if provided.

vbox_power_wait.description: Seconds to wait after a power-off command before sending a power-on — prevents race conditions with rapid fencing.
